record.question: What is a deadlock in an operating system?
options: When a process is stuck in an infinite loop
When two or more processes wait for each other indefinitely
When a process executes without waiting
When a process releases a resource before using it
record.explanation: Deadlock occurs when processes wait indefinitely for resources held by one another. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026.
